mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.child_id, c.name AS category_name, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r JOIN T_TDP_REQCTGR_R rc ON r.id = rc.today_permission_id JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON rc.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE r.parent_id = #{parentId} AND DATE(r.created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT r.id, r.child_id, c.name AS category_name, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r JOIN T_TDP_REQCTGR_R rc ON r.id = rc.today_permission_id JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON rc.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE r.child_id = #{childId} AND DATE(r.created_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TDP_REQ_L (parent_id, child_id, reason, status, expired_at, created_at) VALUES ( #{parentId}, #{childId}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), NOW() )

INSERT INTO T_TDP_REQCTGR_R (today_permission_id, merchant_category_id, created_at) VALUES
(#{permissionId}, #{categoryId}, NOW())
